units.source_text: 大谷大学门前行人稀疏，车辆也甚少，

en.t: In front of Otani University, pedestrians were sparse, and there were very few vehicles,

units.source_text: 只偶尔传来行驶在京都站前至乌龙车库前的市营电车路轨上的电车的呐声。

en.t: with only the occasional sound of a municipal streetcar running along the tracks from Kyoto Station to Karasuma Garage.

units.source_text: 马路对面的大学生体育场的古老门柱，

en.t: Across the road stood the old gateposts of the university athletic field,

units.source_text: 与这边的正门相对而立，左边延伸着嫩叶成费的银杏街树。

en.t: facing the main gate on this side, while to the left stretched a row of ginkgo trees thick with fresh young leaves.
